notes: Product family OSP1-3120NxR; ordering variants OSP1-3120NCR (0°C~+70°C) and OSP1-3120NTR (-40°C~+85°C). Case operating temperature Industrial grade -40~85°C per Recommended Operating Conditions table. Data rate Dr max 1 Mbps (not Gbps). Power supply Icc max 50 mA at Vcc 3.13–3.47 V; power in watts not stated. Transmitter center wavelength λC 1270–1360 nm (typ 1310 nm); receiver center wavelength λC 1270–1610 nm. Total jitter 0.431 UI (unit UI, not ps). Transmitter spectral width (RMS) σ max 4 nm. Optical rise/fall Tr-Tf max 0.26 ns. Output optical eye compliant with IEEE802.3 z (class 1 laser safety). Receiver sensitivity and overload per footnote 3 (footnote text not in excerpt).
suggestions: Consider a separate field for data rate in Mbps or UI for total jitter; support list[float] for temp_min_c/temp_max_c when multiple temperature grades exist on one datasheet.
